'''January 2001 Melbourne Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck tournament (14 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 14 January 2001. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1635">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-melbourne-australia-14-1-01d1635/ melbourne-australia-14-1-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 17 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-melbourne-australia-14-1-01d1635/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
